messages.title: Raise the dSCRT manager fee ceiling to 15%
messages.description: Authorises migrating lst-core to code id 78, which raises max_performance_fee_bps from 1000 to 1500. The performance fee itself is unchanged at 700 bps and stays the manager's to set beneath the ceiling. Code hash 80edd69fe4d4bb651dd24e949df2b90b0e641a8d9dc5445497cd0d50c77e202b, reproducible from github.com/jirkacepelka/SteakSCRT at commit 4a7d684 with `npm run build`.

title: Raise the dSCRT manager fee ceiling to 15%
summary: Migrate lst-core (secret1lj23n74aan7nlgj6hfm45fh3gc7h2ctdplsw8y) to code id 78. This raises the ceiling on the performance fee the manager may set, from 10% to 15%. It does not raise the fee, which stays at 7%. The migration writes only that one figure; the manager, treasury, validator-weight ceiling, exchange rate and every open withdrawal window are unaffected. Code hash 80edd69fe4d4bb651dd24e949df2b90b0e641a8d9dc5445497cd0d50c77e202b.
